slide1.headline: OpenAI and Broadcom Unveil Custom AI Inference Chip
slide1.subtitle: A significant development in AI chip technology

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: OpenAI and Broadcom unveiled their first custom AI inference chip on 24 Jun 2026.
The chip was developed in a 9-month cycle.
Target deployment is by the end of 2026.

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: This development could lead to more efficient AI processing.
It may enhance the performance of AI models in various applications.
The partnership between OpenAI and Broadcom is a significant step in AI innovation.

posts.caption: OpenAI and Broadcom have made a significant breakthrough in AI chip development. Their custom AI inference chip, developed in just 9 months, is set to deploy by the end of 2026. This could revolutionize AI processing and enhance model performance. Questions to consider: What impact will this have on the AI industry? slide1.headline: Qualcomm Acquires Modular for $3.9 Billion
slide1.subtitle: A major acquisition in the AI software industry

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Qualcomm acquired AI software startup Modular for $3.9 billion on 24 Jun 2026.
This acquisition is a significant investment in AI technology.
Modular's AI software will enhance Qualcomm's portfolio.

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: This acquisition demonstrates Qualcomm's commitment to AI innovation.
It may lead to the development of more advanced AI software solutions.
The deal value of $3.9 billion indicates the growing importance of AI in the tech industry.

slide4.title: INSIGHTS
bullets: Qualcomm's acquisition of Modular is a strategic move to expand its AI capabilities.
The deal highlights the increasing demand for AI software solutions.

slide1.headline: Nasdaq 100 Set to Drop $1 Trillion Amid Tech Selloff
slide1.subtitle: A significant downturn in the tech industry

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: The Nasdaq 100 is set to drop $1 trillion amid a tech selloff on 23 Jun 2026.
This downturn is attributed to a decline in tech stocks, including SpaceX.
The valuation of SpaceX has slipped, contributing to the overall decline.

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: This tech selloff may have far-reaching implications for the industry.
It could lead to a decline in investor confidence and a slowdown in innovation.
The impact on the global economy could be significant, with potential ripple effects on other markets.
